author: rawmodels
description:
Unslop (Harbor)
	

200 Harbor tasks with the reward we trained
AlexWortega/Qwen3.8-27B-antislop on. Your model finishes a
tweet or writes a HumanEval function body. Claude Opus 5.5 grades it against a rubric frozen for that task, ignoring
length. A fixed rule handles length separately. Code has to pass its tests before the judge reads it.

	
		




		
Tasks
100 tweet continuations, 100 HumanEval bodies; half EN, half RU


Splits
8 train / 4 validation / 38 test per domain and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/rawmodels/unslop-harbor.
